expand2.text:
# SymEngine benchmarks/expand2.cpp, commit
# 0c183629a35dd9d8123fafcc47b0e0283bbae80d.
:.symbolic
:.time

x: R
y: R
z: R
w: R
e: (x + y + z + w)^15
expression: e * (e + w)
started: monotonic()
expanded: expand(expression)
elapsed: (monotonic() - started) * 1000
:: elapsed
:: term_count(expanded)

add1.text:
# SymEngine benchmarks/add1.cpp, commit
# 0c183629a35dd9d8123fafcc47b0e0283bbae80d.
:.symbolic
:.time

x: R
coefficient_value: 1
accumulator: polynomial(x, 3000)
started: monotonic()
..2999 >>
    add_term(accumulator, coefficient_value, $)
    .coefficient_value *: -1
elapsed: (monotonic() - started) * 1000
:: elapsed
# SymEngine Add.get_dict() excludes the separately stored constant term.
:: term_count(accumulator) - 1
